reviews.title: Remarkable App & Developer
reviews.text:
I rarely ever write reviews, let alone for a mobile app but I absolutely feel inclined to write one for Pushy. 

I was having a deep struggle with waking up on time and getting over the half asleep instincts in the morning, so I began looking for many different solutions until stumbling across this app. When using its fitness oriented wake up strategy, it helped me out immensely to get over that mental block in the morning.

Fast forward to today, I saw that Pushy has had a massive update including incorporating lots of new features and a subscription plan. With this, the developer chose to give all users who used the app prior to this major update lifetime premium access for being early adopters. This action alone communicates a lot about the developer’s integrity, showing that he isn’t simply developing this app for a quick buck, but that he genuinely appreciates his community and is willing to invest back into those who used his app early.

I would highly recommend Pushy not only because it’s an effective solution to anybody struggling to take hold over their mornings, but also because it’s being made with love and passion from a single person simply trying to lead a wave in making others’ lives a bit easier, a rare quality in the mobile app space.
